title: Small Hydraulic Press Brakes, 33–66 Ton NC & CNC | NovoTech
meta_description: Small hydraulic press brakes: 33, 44 and 66 ton NC models from 4.2 to 6.9 ft and a 44-ton 3-axis CNC with Cybelec control and Promecam tooling. Parts in Canada.
intro: A compact hydraulic press brake bends sheet metal between a punch and a V-die under hydraulic force — here 33 to 66 US tons over 4.2 to 6.9 ft, the size that fits a sheet-metal shop rather than a steel-fabrication plant. ISITAN's Edgebender range bends up to 8 ga over 4.2 to 6.9 ft with 33 to 66 US tons — the press brake for HVAC fittings, enclosures, brackets, signage and job-shop work where a 100-ton machine is more than you need. The NC models set the angle and backgauge from a stored program; the Edgebender 1240 CNC adds independent Y1 / Y2 cylinders and a Cybelec Cybtouch 12 touchscreen. European hydraulics, electrics and safety light guards on every machine, with CSA-approved panels and support from Mississauga, ON, Canada. For larger machines see the Dener CNC press brakes and NovoTech's value-line CNC press brakes.

faq.a: Bending force depends on the sheet thickness, the bend length and the V-die opening: in mild steel about 575 × t² ÷ V US tons per foot, with t and V in inches. In a V of 8 × the thickness, a 4 ft bend takes about 16 US tons in 16 ga, 39 tons in 10 ga and 47 tons in 8 ga (0.16″); a wider die lowers the force — 8 ga in a 2″ V takes about 31 tons over 4 ft — at the cost of a larger inside radius. The NC control calculates the exact force for the tool and material you enter; send us your thickest and longest bend and we will size the machine.

The 2-axis NC Edgebender sets the bending angle (Y) and the backgauge (X) from a program — enough for most job-shop bending. The 3-axis CNC Edgebender 1240 controls the two cylinders independently (Y1, Y2), so the beam can be tilted for compensation and the Cybelec Cybtouch 12 gives graphic programming, angle correction and tool libraries like a full-size CNC press brake.

The Edgebenders use Promecam-style (European) quick-release clamping, the most common tooling standard in Canada, with a standard top tool and bottom die included. Segmented punches, gooseneck tools and special dies are available — see our Eurostamp press brake tooling page.

faq.q: Are they safe to run without a separate guarding system?
faq.a: Every Edgebender carries a Leuze front light guard with learning mode, side covers with safety switches, a programmable backgauge retract and a CE-compliant foot pedal with emergency stop; DSP and Fiessler laser systems are available as options.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
